verdict.rationale: Browserbase ships its own agents (a dashboard Agent and the Stagehand SDK), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows users can register or plug external MCP servers into it to use their tools. The documented official MCP server (probe-3) is the opposite role: it exposes Browserbase to other agents, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
